name: Rodd & Gunn
verdict: New Zealand menswear brand; register-listed shareholders are a US private fund, family trusts and individuals (largest: Winona R&G, LLC). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: official partner (merchandise partner) of the Black Foils (SailGP team page, fetched 2026-09-30). Register share parcels list Winona R&G, LLC with 126,651,805 of 221,017,780 shares; other holders include CEO Michael Beagley and his trust, and Zippin Pty Ltd.
